scope: Actual production bundle in the existing VM/DOM harness: bounded canonical settings transaction, history rollback/refusal/reentrancy, cache and playback preservation, committed warnings, and Movement UI routing. Not browser acceptance.

results.name: Detached settings edit records one snapshot and preserves unrelated canonical values, typed buffers, caches and playback
One transaction can change both settings owners and Undo/Redo exactly restores the canonical project
Unchanged settings and empty patches are true no-ops
Unknown owners, nested/prototype fields, wrong primitive types and out-of-range settings reject atomically
Missing or stale project guards reject edits, including replacement by identical data
Paused history and unwritable settings refuse before history or state mutation
Detached validation failure leaves project, dirty flag, history, playback and live settings references intact
A validator cannot reenter the settings transaction, and failure releases the lock
Snapshot refusal, silence, double recording and post-record exceptions restore complete Undo/Redo state
History eviction remains owned by the retained snapshot engine and failed recording restores evicted entries
Settings edits never invoke whole-project commit or mutate a detached validation result
Notification and refresh failures are explicit committed warnings with dirty, Undoable data
Movement UI routes Apply through one shared transaction and retains the four-field boundary
Movement cancellation and replay rejection never enter the shared settings transaction
